g.text: 3 · Cut the pie in vertical slices
Everyone has an opinion on how you should cut a pie. Mine: vertical, front end and back end in the same slice, shippable on its own.
FRONT END
BACK END
EFFORT
TO BUILD
FUNCTIONALITY
slice 1
A horizontal cut ships a back end nobody can use,
or a front end wired to nothing. YAGNI assured.
HOW YOU GET THERE
1 · Visualize the whole pie
the full product, all the details, out loud
2 · Map the scopes
OAuth setup, multi-merchant, consent screen, server spinup, tools, auditability
3 · Identify slices
increments at different scopes you can actually ship
slice 1 of the MCP example
OAuth + MCP server with 2 read tools
front end and back end, end to end, shippable, boring on purpose
You can just ask Claude to provide you with the vertical slices itself,
but it is fun to do the thought experiment yourself. Do it while rambling.
THE TEST
If the slice cannot go to production alone, it is not a slice. It is a phase of your plan.
